title: MemPhant evidence contract
description: The single schema for the `evidence_contract` block that every promotion-capable result artifact must carry. Each required field traces to a measurement failure we actually committed. Validated by scripts/check_evidence_contract.py, which reads THIS FILE for the required/type/enum rules and adds the cross-field guards that a JSON Schema cannot express. Fail closed: a missing field is a violation, never a pass-by-default. Any field whose value cannot be verified from a banked artifact must be the literal string "unverified" -- never an invented number -- and an artifact carrying any "unverified" value must have decisional=false.

decisional.description: May this artifact carry a promotion/kill decision? Guards downgrade it; nothing upgrades it automatically.

claim.description: The one sentence this artifact is cited for.

power.description: Failures 1 and 2: underpowered runs reported as nulls, and power asserted rather than computed. Two-sided exact McNemar has NO rejection region below n_d = 6.

n_d.description: Observed discordant pairs, b + c. THE gate: n_d < 6 forces decisional=false.

mde_at_80.description: Minimum detectable effect at 80% power. Must be COMPUTED by scripts/instrument_power.py from n and psi -- the checker recomputes it and rejects a mismatch. A prose claim ("~80% power at psi~=0.15") is not a value.

source.description: The banked artifact the cells were counted from.

mechanism_enabled.description: Failure 5: a probe that ran with the mechanism switched off. Required whenever probe_kind is set. A null result with mechanism_enabled=false is a hard failure -- it is the failure that most looks like a result.

probe_kind.description: Set this whenever the artifact tests whether a mechanism does something.

mechanism_evidence.description: The configuration key/flag and its observed value proving the mechanism was on (or off).

harness.description: Failure 6: harness settings not recorded beside scores. A default is not evidence merely because it was the default -- the whole code lane ran --embed-model off and 'dense is useless' became a near-architectural conclusion from it.

corpus.description: Failure 7: corpora that mutate under their own lock (Track U broke mid-run when a concurrent session wrote a feedback_* file, 90 -> 91). A live path is not an identity.

path.description: Optional; if it names a tracked in-repo file the checker recomputes sha256 against it.

leakage.description: Failure 3: leakage collapsed to one number. It is a five-tuple and is never comparable across differing unit definitions (same bank: 'user turn + agent reply' 0.3367/1.4991x vs 'user turn only' 0.1871/1.3657x).

unit_definition.description: Free text, required. What one memory unit IS. Absolute coverage is not portable across unit definitions.

provenance_class.description: Failure 3, second half: contamination (the query was authored FROM the target -- a fact, settled by provenance) is not lexical tractability (real, but then the bank only measures the lexical regime). ONLY contamination disqualifies.

leakage_comparisons.description: Absolute coverages being compared against each other. Every entry must share one unit_definition or the comparison is void.

bar.description: Failure 4: bars preregistered below the achievable floor, three times. A bar must cite a recorded floor and may not sit below it.

instrument_verification.description: Failure 8: instruments trusted from cards and READMEs. SWE-Explore ships 0/848 issue texts; ClawArena's MIT is a shields.io badge; swe-prbench ships 3.3% bot comments while claiming zero; STATE-Bench's adapter 400s on every call and would have billed $211-634 for zero rows.

fields_counted.description: field name -> rows on which the field is actually populated. This is what catches 0/848.

license_source.description: A badge is not a licence. "badge", "README", and "card" are rejected by the enum.

attribution.description: Failure 9, second half: 'pre-existing at my base' hid the same regression twice, because the base already contained it.
